meta.accuracy_policy: implementation_over_documentation; unknown stays unknown; never invented
meta.scope: uri starts with api/ EXCEPT exact api/documentation* and api/oauth2-callback
meta.classification_rule: SYSTEM first (webhook/callback/signed/broadcasting markers incl. throttle 30,1/payment-callback/payment-webhook/BroadcastController); then STAFF/ADMIN (throttle:admin or permission:/role:); then CUSTOMER (auth:sanctum, no admin markers); else PUBLIC
meta.general_expansion: 130 custom route entries expanded on | methods (GET|POST, PUT|PATCH) to one endpoint per method
meta.general_conversion_rules: name=METHOD path — short purpose; raw={{base_url}}/path with :param; Accept always; Content-Type only with body; Bearer customer_token/admin_token by audience, none for public/system; lang:en on non-system (CheckLangMiddleware proven, gspec.locale); query from example_request.query else empty; GET=no body; body-required only where example_request.body or spec filters prove it; tests: none added (no verified capture paths in general surface)
meta.postman_rules: dedup by loose(method+path) (numeric segments≈params, paths verbatim incl. double-v1); first occurrence wins; same-fragment repeats kept as proven variants with suffix; folders Admin/General/System(+Legacy); General subfolders in dependency order Register/Login→Products→Cart→Checkout→Payment→Order
meta.collection_events: no collection-level events (none or divergent fragment events — see merge-report)
meta.parity_breakdown: 511 route:list rows in scope; 537 unified spec endpoints (method-expanded splits e.g. GET|HEAD/PUT|PATCH, general 130-route expansion, closure-verified product-type); 542 postman requests (spec set + proven variants: checkout x4, product-variable, register-email). missing_from_postman=0 (template-aware match incl. example-valued paths).
meta.stage2_finalizer: postprocess-from-files.php: base_url host-only, triple-brace fix, token re-audience, destructive warnings, script guards, register-email variant, mislabeled-settings correction, product-type/seal spec corrections

mechanisms: sanctum Bearer admin token via POST /api/v1/admin-login (type=admin) — {{admin_token}}
sanctum Bearer customer token via POST /api/v1/token — {{access_token}} (user/* only)
Stripe-Signature + Paypal-Transmission-* provider signatures on webhooks (no Bearer)
public guest: enum-types, callbacks, track-order (email/phone verified)

auth_matrix.authenticated: middleware ['api','auth:sanctum','throttle:authenticated'] (routes/api.php:142). Sanctum bearer required; no bearer -> 401 {message:'Unauthenticated.'}. Sub-scope: mark-paid routes add permission:payments.mark_paid; coupons/claim uses ClaimCouponRequest + CouponClaimService (409 conflict reasons, 404 unknown id, 500 fallback).
auth_matrix.guest: middleware ['api','throttle:public-api'] (routes/api.php:52). No auth. Exception: GET coupons index returns 401 envelope {message:'Unauthenticated.',success:false} when a bearer token IS presented but resolves to no user (CouponController@index); guests with no header unaffected.
auth_matrix.signed_url: middleware ['signed','throttle:30,1'], no Sanctum. Ownership enforced at URL issuance; controller re-checks entitlement/status/limits.

tokens.access_token: legacy alias for customer bearer (preserved verbatim in older items)
tokens.token: legacy alias used by general examples (mapped to customer_token in generated items)

classes.signed_group: throttle:30,1 on signed invoice/digital URLs; invoices/verify has throttle:5,1.

throttles.admin_global: admin 400/min (user-or-IP), analytics 60/min, authenticated 300/min, login 5/min/IP, public-api 120/min/IP, payment-callback 20/min/IP, payment-webhook 20/min/IP, public-tracking 10/min/IP, sensitive 5/min, otp 3/min, cart 20/min, refunds 5/min (all proven in AppServiceProvider + RouteServiceProvider)

general.example_404_slug: {status:404,message:'<translated NOT_FOUND>',success:false} (no data key). Thrown by null-check controllers (brand/banner/slider/tag/promotion/product/flash-sale/geo/city/pickup).
general.example_paginated: {status:200,message:'<translated FETCH_DATA_SUCCESSFULLY>',success:true,data:{data:[...],links:{...},meta:{...}}} for LengthAwarePaginator resources (categories, tags, content-pages, products).
general.example_success: {status:200,message:'<translated FETCH_DATA_SUCCESSFULLY>',success:true,data:{...}|[...]}. Message keys pass through ApiResponse::translateNotice (lang/message.php, fallback raw key).
general.shape: packages/marvel/src/Traits/ApiResponse.php :: apiResponse($message,$status,$success,$data) -> {status,message,success,data?}. data key OMITTED when empty. 404-envelope controllers return apiResponse(NOT_FOUND,404,false) with no data.
general.validation_422: FormRequest failures -> standard Laravel 422 {message:'The ... field ...',errors:{field:[...]}}. Applies to FlashSaleIndexRequest, SelectCurrencyRequest, ClaimCouponRequest, ReviewCreate/UpdateRequest, FastCheckoutRequest, coupons/available page+limit.

admin.wrapper: Marvel\Traits\ApiResponse {status,message,success,data?} HTTP=status; Marvel FormRequest failedValidation returns raw {field:[msg]} 422 (no envelope)

enums.note: catalog pricing boundary: ProductPricingService methods listed in catalog-spec.meta.pricing_boundary

admin.wrapper: Marvel\Traits\ApiResponse {status,message,success,data?} HTTP=status; Marvel FormRequest failedValidation returns raw {field:[msg]} 422 (no envelope)
admin.throttles: admin 400/min (user-or-IP), analytics 60/min, authenticated 300/min, login 5/min/IP, public-api 120/min/IP, payment-callback 20/min/IP, payment-webhook 20/min/IP, public-tracking 10/min/IP, sensitive 5/min, otp 3/min, cart 20/min, refunds 5/min (all proven in AppServiceProvider + RouteServiceProvider)
admin.exports: Analytics exports are SYNC CSV downloads (no async jobs, no status/cancel/download). Catalog import/export (products/brands/categories) DO use async status/cancel/download — analytics does not.
admin.unreachable: All /api/v1/v1/* paths carry unreachable:true (double-v1 prefix stacking).

locale.header_proof: Proven via app/Http/Middleware/CheckLangMiddleware.php: $request->header('lang','en'); allowlist ['en','ar']; App::setLocale($lang). Invalid values silently ignored (no 422). Marvel admin route groups also carry the 'lang' middleware alias.
locale.resources: All translatable resources render via getTranslation(field, app()->getLocale()). Admin SettingResource + Country/Governorate/City resources switch shape on request()->routeIs(...) — see gaps G8/G9.

currency.effective_code: App\Services\Currency\CurrencyService::getEffectiveCode(?User) — catalog code when selection disabled (default), else user preference / guest cookie. Proven: CurrencyService.php getEffectiveCode + isCurrencySelectionEnabled + guest-cookie branch.
currency.header_proof: NO currency header. Repo-wide search for header()/guest_currency/X-Currency in app + packages/marvel returned ZERO currency-header hits. Currency travels via POST v1/general/currencies/select {currency_code} (SelectCurrencyRequest, auth optional) and server-side effective-code resolution.
currency.rendering: Prices converted in resources via ConvertsProductPrice::convertCatalogPrice + effectiveCurrency() (ProductResource, ProductMiniResource, BrandProductResource). Brand/Product controllers build currency-aware cache keys (fullUrl + effective code); search requests bypass cache (ProductController::shouldCache).

slug_binding.admin_implicit: ONLY implicit binding in scope: Marvel admin static-pages/{static_page:slug} (+ nested {static_section}).
slug_binding.geo_ids: governorates/{id}, countries/{id}, cities/{id}, pickup-locations/{id} are NUMERIC ids with ->whereNumber() route constraints (not slugs). Lookup: repository findById + status/active check (cities: no status check — gap G2).
slug_binding.public_manual: All public {slug} routes bind MANUALLY via where('slug',$slug) (brands uses Brand::active()->search('slug',$slug,locale)). No implicit route-model binding on the public side. Extra public shortcut: index accepts ?slug= and delegates to the slug handler (categories, brands, banners, sliders, promotions, flash-sales).
